February, 2024
Author: Pankaj Bhatia

Bench: Pankaj Bhatia
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc-Lko:13855
Court No. - 12
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 1758 of 2024
Applicant :- Mahadei

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Civil Secrt. Lko.
Counsel for Applicant :- Sumit Chauhan,Ankit Kumar Yadav,Atul Kumar Singh
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and perused the record.

2. The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in Fir No.159 of 2023, under Sections 498A, 304B Ipc
and Section 3/4 of D.P. Act, Police Station Khamriya, District Kheri.

entities.text: D.P. Act, Police Station Khamriya, District Kheri
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 3.  It is argued by the Counsel for the applicant that on the same allegations, the father-in-law of the deceased has been enlarged on bail by this Court vide order dated 24.01.2024 passed in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.15361 of 2023.

entities.text: Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.15361 of 2023

entities.text: Mahadei vs State Of U.P Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Civil
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 4. Learned A.G.A. vehemently opposed the bail prayer.

5. Considering the fact that on similar allegations, the co-accused Ramjeevan, who is the father-in-law, has been enlarged on bail coupled with the fact that the applicant, who is the mother-in-law, has no criminal antecedents and is in custody since 16.09.2023, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail on the ground of parity.
Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

6. Let the applicant Mahadei be released on bail in the abovesaid first information report number on his furnishing personal bonds and two reliable sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
Order Date :- 16.2.2024 akverma  Mahadei vs State Of U.P Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Civil ... on 16 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/55681041/
